purpose: Fixed historical rival-winning-threshold prior. Training diagnostic only; must pass separate fresh reactive holdout before any policy adoption.

fixture.sourceScope: Ended-match public evidence only. Frozen historical rival thresholds are counterfactual screening, not reactive validation or live proof. Never feed future threshold/word events to the live policy.

labelRule: When originally own win: public paid is rival maximum (reserve1 conservatively ambiguous0/1). Other winner: ended archived winning maximum. No winner:0. Never use our archived winning maximum as rival threshold.
phaseRule: phase=min(4,floor(5*(round-1)/(round+roundsRemaining-1))); roundsRemaining includes current auction. Sampler separately uses last-usable bucket5 at remaining2; remaining1 is unusable and returns0.

model.type: Hierarchical empirical quantile prior, fixed smoothing, no tuned hyperparameters
model.parentMixture: 0.75 face×phase +0.25 count×phase, then count×face×phase, then count×letter×phase
model.clamp: Optional hard upper bound max known public opponent balance, excluding focal seat. Disable for hypothetical future steps, where future opponent cashouts are unknown.

leaveOneMatchOut.method: Each model trained on19 matches, tested on remaining whole match. Fixed strengths, no hyperparameter selection. All usable auctions; no current balance caps available in fixture, so evaluation is unclamped.

caveats: 20 games are observational, not randomized; seven-player strata contain only2 games.
Auction rows within a match are dependent; reported errors are predictive summaries, not independent-row confidence intervals.
Own wins have selection-dependent labels equal to paid; other-winner archived maxima are the relevant missing upper-order statistic.
Empirical priors need fresh reactive policy evaluation. Leave-one-match-out predictive calibration is not an independent gameplay test.

Actual rival balances at each auction are not included in the immutable compact fixture. Hard balance caps are applied only from caller-provided current public context, and cannot be cross-validated here.
